name: Research project workspace
one_line: REFUSED. One project's mixed working materials, recommended project then stage then artifact_type — which is word-for-word the Research schema's own default template, so this row is the schema's default situation wearing a template id, not a second organizational situation.
design_cite: 00 states this row's entire content as a property of the Research SCHEMA, not of a separate situation: "a Research template may define project → stage → artifact type". The research schema row (planning/domains/nodes/research.json) already carries exactly that dimension_order with exactly that citation. ALIGNMENT.md is the binding rule and it names this shape precisely: "A template that would only repeat its schema’s fields and dimension_order **is not a node** — it is the schema’s default template." CONNECTION.md section 2 restates it as the node test, and CONNECTION.md section 8 confirms nothing breaks when the row is absent: destination_dimensions resolves "a template id, or a schema id resolving through the schema's default template".
refuse_reason:
Fails the template half of the node test on all three limbs at once — detection signals, recommended dimensions, and privacy rules are the Research schema's, not this situation's.

1. DIMENSIONS — identical. The roster's own one_line_hint for this id reads "The Research schema's default situation: one project's working materials arranged project, then stage, then artifact_type (00's own recommendation)". research.json's template block is [project, stage, artifact_type], sourced to 00's "a Research template may define project → stage → artifact type". Writing it twice would put one recommendation in two rows, which is what the academic.coursework node already flagged as an open question on its own schema; here there is not even a narrowing to justify the second copy.

2. DETECTION SIGNALS — a complement, not a signal. Every concrete signal a project workspace could claim is either (a) already on the research schema row, or (b) the structural fingerprint of a NAMED SIBLING template on the same schema. The roster gives this schema nine templates; between them they take the manuscript lifecycle (research.manuscript-publication), abstracts/posters/decks (research.conference-presentation, which the roster also makes file_kind_owner of presentation), notebooks/SOPs/instrument records (research.lab-notebook-protocols), datasets and analysis (research.dataset-analysis, file_kind_owner of spreadsheet), proposals and budgets (research.grants-funding), IRB and consent (research.ethics-compliance), papers by others (research.reading-library), and the degree project (research.thesis-dissertation). What remains for this id is 'a project identifier fires and no sibling's structure dominates' — a definition by complement. That is the schema activating, with P10 resolving the schema's default template, which CONNECTION.md section 8 already specifies as a supported path.

3. PRIVACY RULES — identical. The sensitivity value and its reasoning are copied from research.json verbatim in substance (unpublished work, human-subjects material, editorial correspondence). The sharper privacy rules on this schema belong to research.ethics-compliance (participants) and research.manuscript-publication (embargoed and pre-publication material), not here.

FIXTURE EVIDENCE that the id is a label: of the eleven files researched below, exactly one (PVA-RDP_project_plan_v3.docx, and its sparse cousin notes_2026-03-11.md) is not claimed by a named sibling — and that one is reached by the schema's default template with no signal this row could add. PVA-RDP_manuscript_v7.docx and submission.zip → research.manuscript-publication. Protocol_RNA-extraction_v2.docx and Notebook_2026-03_p14_scan.pdf → research.lab-notebook-protocols. results_batch07.xlsx → research.dataset-analysis. IRB_Protocol_PVA-RDP_2026_signed.pdf → research.ethics-compliance. Abstract_PVA-RDP_UChicago.pdf → research.conference-presentation (and 00's own two-schema case with college_applications). Ravikumar_2019_NatureMethods.pdf → research.reading-library / the Reading Inbox residual. Lab 4 writeup.docx → the academic schema. analysis/train_eval.py → the code schema.

Refusing costs nothing downstream: the situation's material still activates the research schema on its own evidence, and P10 still reaches [project, stage, artifact_type] through the schema row. Padding this row would produce a second stored copy of one recommendation and a detection-signal list that is the union of its own siblings — the failure ALIGNMENT names and the shape the 574 produced at scale.

recognition.deterministic_note: Deliberately empty, and that emptiness IS the finding. Every deterministic signal this situation could state is already authored on the research schema row (project-identifier token beside research-artifact structure; a labelled Project or Protocol Title slot; a submission-lifecycle term beside manuscript or venue evidence; an archive manifest read without unpacking; a zone-restricted venue gazetteer hit; the repository-marker precedence check that runs before research is admitted on a code_structured file). Restating them under a template id would not make them this row's, it would make one signal set exist twice.
recognition.needs_llm_note: Same finding. The interpretive calls a project workspace raises — is this handwritten page a lab record or a lecture note, is this image a research figure at all, does this project token name the holder's own work or one merely cited — are the research schema row's, and the sibling-specific ones (is this archive a submission packet; is this prose stage evidence) belong to research.manuscript-publication.
never_alone: A project-shaped token alone. This is the tempting false file for exactly this row: a directory named for the project, whose members are a downloaded paper, a stock figure and an unrelated spreadsheet, would let a workspace template swallow all three on the folder name. 00 forbids the equivalent move for institutions — a university name alone should not create a group — and requires the same restraint here, because the token must sit beside research-artifact structure before it is a project fact. Restated from the research schema row; not distinct to this id.

A parent folder named for the project alone, with no member file carrying in-file project-plus-structure evidence. 00 keeps folder context as a clue and not a licence: "The system learns from existing folders but must not silently reorganize them." A workspace-shaped template is the row most likely to violate this, which is a reason to be careful about the situation, not a reason to make it a node.

A same-session download batch as proof that a set of files is one project — 00: "A session should never be treated as proof of topic". Fixture: the four papers downloaded beside Ravikumar_2019_NatureMethods.pdf.

A bare 4-digit number as a project id or a year — 00 warns of "numbers that look like years but are course identifiers, version numbers, build numbers, ZIP codes, or other unrelated values"; in this domain it is as likely a run number, a plate number or an instrument model. Fixture: results_batch07.xlsx.

A source_type or extension alone. text_document, spreadsheet, presentation, image, ocr, archive, code_structured, calendar, email, design_creative and opaque_binary all appear in a project's working directory and none of them makes this situation plausible; 00 requires the engine to "treat the file extension as a routing signal rather than an assumption about meaning".
A filename alone on an unreadable instrument file — 00: "the system should not infer a purpose from their filename alone".

work_types_note: Empty by refusal, not by omission. The artifact_type values a project workspace holds (manuscript, protocol, figure, dataset, analysis notebook, presentation slides, meeting notes, project plan) are already enumerated on the research schema row as VALUES of artifact_type. 00: "The system may create new values when it sees a new course, project, company, university, or event, but it should not invent new fields automatically." project plan and meeting notes are the two the schema row does not list; that is a value-list gap for R1c, not a licence for this row.

template.why: No dimension order is authored here, because the order this situation would recommend is already authored on the research schema row and sourced to 00's own sentence: "a Research template may define project → stage → artifact type". The reason project leads is 00's ordering rule — "For document and record domains, project, function, or subject usually comes before time because putting year first scatters related work across calendar folders" — and a stage such as revision, or an artifact type such as figure, is unintelligible without the project. Both statements are the schema's, not this row's. What the situation genuinely needs from 00 is uneven depth rather than a second row: "The product should not force every branch to use the full template or have the same number of levels", and "each branch should offer the dimensions that are actually present in its member groups". A mixed working directory typically populates project and artifact_type richly and stage barely, so the honest recommendation is the schema default with stage flattened where no lifecycle evidence exists — a per-branch flattening the user performs on the canvas, since "The system recommends an order based on the domain template, but the user can reverse, remove, add, or flatten dimensions." That is a use of the default template, not a different template.

file_kinds.note: Not authored here. The plausible source types for this material are the research schema row's eleven, and the roster already assigns presentation to research.conference-presentation and spreadsheet to research.dataset-analysis as file_kind_owner. A refused row must not re-claim them. never_alone stays true because 00 makes it constitutional for file-kind evidence regardless of which row carries it.

sensitivity_why: Recorded, and its sameness is part of the refusal. The value and its reason are the research schema row's: a project's working directory routinely holds unpublished manuscripts, internal figures and, where the project has human subjects, participant material, and 00 requires mail material to be handled "while treating addresses and message content as potentially sensitive". No privacy rule here differs from the schema's, which is the third limb of the node test. The rules that DO differ on this schema live on research.ethics-compliance (participant-facing material) and research.manuscript-publication (pre-publication and embargoed drafts). The value is 00's phrase and nothing more; a handling class is P7's and none is assigned here.
open_question: Two findings for R1c or Joseph, neither of which rescues this row. (1) The research schema row's falls_through_to omits Review Later, yet five of its own fixtures — and four of this node's — fall through there; the residual list on that row looks incomplete, and Review Later is the roster's own must_consider_residual for this id. (2) The roster makes research.conference-presentation the file_kind_owner of presentation and research.dataset-analysis the file_kind_owner of spreadsheet, but a project's internal status deck and its raw results workbook are neither a conference output nor an analysis deliverable. With this row refused they route to the research schema and its default template, which is correct; if a later reviewer reads file_kind_owner as exclusive, those two fixtures would be mis-shelved. Whether file_kind_owner is a claim of exclusivity or a claim of primary interest is R1c's to settle, and it is a roster question, not a licence to keep a duplicate default template.
